note: ⚠️ SNG-328 (Erik: 'a way for them to gain these or mint this as time goes on'). Authored `kin` and `interests` are a starting spread; THIS IS HOW THEY ACCRUE. The rule that keeps it honest: A TIE IS MINTED FROM SOMETHING THE WORLD ALREADY RECORDED, never invented at runtime. The engine does not make up a brother — it notices that these two people have been in the same place doing the same thing for a year and gives that a line.

kinTriggers.from: guardIntercept where the same figure guarded the same person 3+ times
kinTriggers.line: {other}, whom they have stood over more than once
kinTriggers.note: ⚠️ THE BEST ONE. A guard relationship IS a tie, and it is already counted — nothing new is recorded.

kinTriggers.from: a successful retrieval between two figures
kinTriggers.line: {other}, who came back up the road for them
kinTriggers.note: the retrieval crafts now produce relationships, not just survivals

kinTriggers.from: both figures present at 2+ arc casualties on the same front

kinTriggers.line: {other}, who has been down the hall for years
kinTriggers.note: ⚠️ this is what makes the_stillhold's three opposed figures into a household rather than a coincidence

kinTriggers.from: a casualty on a front this figure held
kinTriggers.note: ⚠️ A TIE TO SOMEONE DEAD IS STILL A TIE, and it is the one sister_alder is authored with. Grief is a relationship the world can record.

kinTriggers.from: the authored `rivals` field, on first contest between them
kinTriggers.line: {other}, who they have never beaten / who they cannot stop beating
kinTriggers.note: turns the 60/66 rivals field into something that appears in a life rather than only in a sim

interestTriggers.line: the {arc}, which they have not let go of
whatever {other} was really teaching, which was not the craft

interestTriggers.from: a craft used to make something that persisted a season
interestTriggers.line: the {thing} they made, and whether it is still standing

interestTriggers.from: a figure demoted or losing a front
interestTriggers.line: something quiet they took up afterwards

rules.cap: ⚠️ 4 kin and 4 interests. Past that a figure is a list rather than a person, and personalPursuitOf draws from a pool — an unbounded pool makes every draw meaningless.
rules.authoredFirst: authored ties are never displaced; minted ones fill the remaining slots
rules.decay: ⚠️ AN INTEREST CAN LAPSE — no reinforcement in 3 world-years and it drops. KIN DOES NOT: a tie to someone you stood over, or did not reach, is not something you stop having.
rules.theDead: kin whose subject died KEEPS the tie and rewrites the line to past tense. That is the whole reason to model this.

forCCode: every trigger reads something already recorded — guardIntercept counts, arcCasualties, figureTenure, homeLocation, the rivals field, mentor bonds. NOTHING NEW IS TRACKED. Mint on the world tick, cap at 4, and honour authored entries first.
